questions.q: Summary focus: the advantages of cycling to school. Which detail should be left out?
options: "My cousin cycled to school for ten years."
questions.why: A personal anecdote adds no new idea about the focus.

questions.q: Text: "Foxes, hedgehogs and owls have been seen in the park at night." Best summary point?
options: Foxes, hedgehogs and owls are seen there
The park provides a habitat for wildlife
questions.why: Generalise the example into the point it illustrates, in your own words.

questions.q: How are the 15 summary marks split?
questions.why: 10 for selecting relevant ideas, 5 for concise, organised own-words writing.

questions.q: State two rules about the form of the Paper 1 summary.
questions.model: Any two: continuous prose (not notes or bullet points); own words as far as possible; no more than 120 words.
